# `event`

Area: **events** ([all tables](README.md))

TMF events some hub wanted, as sent; stored in the transaction of the change.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Server-generated identifier; the eventId sent. |
| `seq` | `bigint` | no |  | Insertion order: events of one transaction keep the order they happened in. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Database insertion time. |
| `api` | `text` | no |  | The API whose hubs it goes to (TMF620 ... TMF678). |
| `event_type` | `text` | no |  | TMF listener event name, e.g. ProductOrderCreateEvent. |
| `resource` | `text` | no |  | The payload key: the resource, camelCase (productOrder). |
| `resource_id` | `text` | no |  | Id of the resource the event is about. |
| `occurred_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the change happened (application clock); eventTime. |
| `payload` | `jsonb` | no |  | The event body exactly as POSTed to the callbacks. |
